title: ALMA Antennas at Sunset.jpg
author: H. Boffin (ESO)/ALMA (ESO/NAOJ/NRAO)
description: The first three Japanese ALMA antennas of the Atacama Compact Array (ACA) at the ALMA Operation Support Facility, located close to the town of San Pedro de Atacama in the Chilean Atacama Desert, at an altitude of 2900m.
